scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to acknowledge customer distress at [02:50] when she expressed severe panic about family movie night being ruined.

grader.scenario: S-Net Stream TV puck stuck on remote pairing screen after factory reset
grader.notes: Solid technical resolution of Bluetooth remote pairing on Stream puck, but agent failed to acknowledge customer's family movie night distress.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV customer support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Dorothy throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute worry and distress about impending family movie night; agent ignored feelings and moved directly to TV stand clearance.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the remote unpairing and flashing red light accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent maintained accurate details and confirmed contact phone number without repetition.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent guided customer step-by-step through remote reset and pairing commands.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a calm, polite, and helpful tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked targeted diagnostic questions regarding LED status, battery health, and infrared obstruction.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed remote paired, home screen loaded, BBC One stream played, and volume control worked.
